description: Every ESP32 setting, stored in the NVS namespace `ambilight`. Definitions only: GET /config and the POST /save/* bodies reference them. `default` is the value of a fresh (or factory-reset) device; `minimum`/`maximum` is the valid range — out-of-range values sent to the device are clamped, except `ip_octet`.

wifi_ssid.description: Wi-Fi network the device joins in station mode. Empty: no network, the device opens the setup access point.

wifi_pass.description: Wi-Fi password. Never returned by the device; an empty value in POST /save/network keeps the current one.

ota_pass.description: Arduino OTA password. Never returned by the device; an empty value in POST /save/network keeps the current one.

ip_octet.description: Last octet of the static IP in the router's subnet, applied after connecting. 0 = keep the DHCP address. Whether it fits the network is checked at connect time.

num_leds.description: Number of LEDs driven. Saving the calibration sets it to the sum of the sides.

color.description: Static color shown in plain mode, `#rrggbb`. The device returns lowercase.

oneOf.title: plain
oneOf.description: Static color; UDP frames are ignored.

oneOf.title: dynamic
oneOf.description: UDP frames from the TV drive the strip (follows the picture).

start_corner.title: StartCorner
start_corner.description: Screen corner where the strip's first LED is (as seen from the front).

clockwise.description: Strip direction from the start corner, as seen from the front.

gamma.description: Gamma correction applied to TV frames.

saturation.description: Saturation multiplier applied to TV frames (1 = unchanged).

wb_r.description: White balance, red channel scale (255 = unchanged).

wb_g.description: White balance, green channel scale (255 = unchanged).

wb_b.description: White balance, blue channel scale (255 = unchanged).

power_limit_w.description: Maximum estimated strip power; brightness is scaled down for frames above it. 0 = no limit.

pixel_watts.description: Power of one LED pixel at full white and brightness 255 (12 V WS2811, 60 LEDs/m: 14.4 W/m / 20 pixels = 0.72).

power.description: Lighting on. false: the strip stays dark and UDP frames are ignored, in both modes.
